author: embirico
text:
Excited to bring skills to Codex!

They unlock a ton of use cases, speed, & reliability for agents.

Skills in Codex follow the https://t.co/1sBIxskRun standard (H/T @AnthropicAI for the great work), but we've extended them to support more user control with explicit invocation.

quoted.text:
🆕 Codex now officially supports skills

Skills are reusable bundles of instructions, scripts, and resources that help Codex complete specific tasks.

You can call a skill directly with $.skill-name, or let Codex choose the right one based on your prompt. https://t.co/evbKtMkhaU

author: embirico
text:
And we're live!
> codex -m gpt-5.2-codex

The vibes on GPT-5.2 are great, and we're excited to bring you the much-awaited Codex version. It's our best coding agent yet!

With significant jumps in our cyber evals, this will be our most careful, iterative deployment to date: https://t.co/AWA1m05LUm

author: embirico
text: we had a 45min outage just now. resolved and reset rate limits!

quoted.text:
Codex outage resolved.

We suffered a minor outage for last 45 minutes which turned into a global outage for last 30 minutes, this is now resolved and we have reset the rate limits. Please let me know if you still see issues.

author: embirico
text:
EOD update: Today we deployed some more small changes that should help cloud tasks be more affordable.

Bigger improvements in the pipeline for soon!

quoted.text:
Codex cloud tasks are expensive. We're working to help limits go much further.

Just shipped our first small change, that TBH we should have caught earlier:
When a cloud task fails, it no longer counts against limits.

Will keep you posted on more improvements!

author: embirico
text:
We just reset Codex rate limits for everyone, and refunded all Codex credit usage up until 1p PT Friday. Enjoy!

Why: On Thursday we rolled out credits to give users options between our $20 and $200 plans. However we had a bug where we overcharged for cloud task usage by ~2-5x

author: embirico
text:
Lots of excitement about GPT-5 in Codex CLI via your ChatGPT plan. Some details:

1. Yes, if you sign in with ChatGPT, usage is included via your paid plan!

2. Still determining exact rate limits, but the goal is to be generous:
-- Pro users should basically not hit limits

quoted.text:
Pro, Plus, and Team users can sign in with ChatGPT to start coding with GPT-5, with access for Enterprise coming soon.

Usage is included in your plan, with rate limits that vary by plan. We’ll share more details as we learn from usage patterns over the coming weeks.
